subject: Optima + Redwood: integration acceleration & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Danielle Brooks <danielle@optimaconsult.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@optimaconsult.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Optima + Redwood: integration acceleration & onboarding plan

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the intro last month — Optima is excited to move from evaluation to a short, focused onboarding program so our consultants can start delivering solution accelerators that embed Redwood runtime patterns. We put together a first-pass onboarding approach (high-level) and a couple of questions we need clarified before we sync:

- Proposed 4-week enablement timeline (kickoff, tech deep dive, hands-on integration lab, certification) — is that feasible on your side?
- Which specific model variants and deployment modes should we train against for initial SI templates (hosted + private)?
- Any mandatory security questionnaire items we should pre-submit to procurement?

I've attached a compact partner onboarding guide and a redline-friendly SOW draft for scope and staffing. Would you be available for a 30-min sync this week to confirm milestones and ownership?

Attachments: Optima_Redwood_partner_onboarding_guide_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); SOW_draft_Optima_Redwood_20270330.docx (Word, 45KB)

Thanks,
Danielle Brooks
Head of Alliances | Optima Consulting
partners@optimaconsult.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

--

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: Danielle Brooks <danielle@optimaconsult.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Optima + Redwood: integration acceleration & onboarding plan

Danielle — thanks for the clear pack and the SOW draft. Short answers first: 4-week enablement is realistic for a pilot cohort (3 consultants) if we carve out dedicated hours from product engineering for the tech deep dive. For training targets, recommend: hosted API with the Llama-like 13B variant for rapid demos, and a 7B quantized private image for on-prem validation.

Security: please fill out our vendor intake form (link below) and we will prioritize SOC2 evidence. For procurement, we typically need an IP addendum and a data handling annex in the SOW — I've flagged that in the attached redlines.

Suggest we run a 30-min kickoff this Thursday at 10:00 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include the enablement checklist.

Quick asks for the call: please have a named technical lead (someone who will join the integration lab) and confirm the pilot customer use case you plan to demo.

Links: https://hubspot.redwoodinference.com/deals/OPTI-2027-044 | Vendor intake form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOptimaOnboard

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
O: +1 (650) 555-0124 | aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

Thanks Aisha — Thursday 10:00 PT works. Technical lead will be Ethan Ross (eross@acme-cloud.com) — he'll join the call and will own the lab work. Pilot use case: automated extraction + contextual retrieval for support knowledge base migration (we'll share a short PoC deck during the kickoff).

We'll complete the vendor intake form prior to the call and update the SOW with a proposed staffing table.

See you Thursday.

Cheers,
Danielle

Adding a few operational notes ahead of kickoff:

- Lab infra: we'll provision a sandbox project with pre-seeded sample docs and an API key scoped to the pilot models. Expect the token policy and quota to be conservative for the first week.
- Training materials: I'll share a one-hour hands-on lab workbook and a folder with example notebooks. Marissa, can you coordinate the scheduling for the 4-week cohort and internal delivery leads?
- SOW: procurement typically pushes back on open IP language — suggest we insert a short mutual ownership clause for SI templates (Redwood provides runtime templates; Optima owns custom connectors).

I attached a draft lab workbook outline and the recommended model/instance table.

-Ben
